Supergirl is a new movie from DC with Milly Alcock that of course flopped and became hated by a lot of audiences. Once again. And the reason for that is character. That side of the movie is horrendous, to the point where no actor could make these characters work. So today, let's dive into DC's latest failure to see what the hell happened this time.
